name: fm.fyug/mcp
title: Fyug (hosted)
description: Write and check Fyug generative-music documents with no install, and preview them in the browser.

tools.name: check_invention
tools.description: Check whether a complete invention document would load in a local Fyug, without playing it. Returns {loadable, module_count, connection_count}, or the error a local load_invention reports. Documents may define developments inline or use bundled content (list_developments, list_examples); this server reads no file or URL a document names and builds no output modules, and refuses documents that need them, saying which.

json.description: Complete invention JSON string (with modules, connections, etc.), at most 64 KiB.

tools.name: describe_development
tools.description: Inspect an exact ref returned by list_developments, with schema_version: 1. Returns input/output routing and aliased controls, dependencies and asset paths; omits the internal graph. Fails explicitly past 256 KiB. Import by copying ref unchanged into developments with a local name no builtin type or other development uses, then use that name as a module's type.

anyOf.description: An exact installed package version; never a SemVer requirement.
A file and dependency-closure revision relative to the daemon workspace.

tools.name: describe_example
tools.description: Inspect an exact ref returned by list_examples: its dependencies and assets, without the full internal graph. Does not play it; pass the ref to load_invention for that. Fails explicitly past 256 KiB.

anyOf.description: An exact installed package version; never a SemVer requirement.
A file and dependency-closure revision relative to the daemon workspace.

ContentRef.description: A portable exact package coordinate or a revision of daemon workspace content.

tools.name: describe_module
tools.description: Inspect one builtin module type: pass type with optional config (omit it for the type's defaults). Response payload: 64 KiB.

config.description:
Type-specific config with creation's defaults/validation. Omit or null for defaults.
Not accepted with module_id. Maximum serialized size: 16 KiB.

module_id.description: Existing running instance ID; reads actual ports and controls without rebuilding.

type.description: Registered type name. Omit when selecting a running module_id.

tools.name: describe_module_types
tools.description: List the builtin module type names. Pass detail: full for default-config ports/controls and explicit per-type errors. Payload limit: 64 KiB; narrow oversized queries. Use describe_module for a supplied config.

detail.description: Defaults to index; request full explicitly for default-config metadata.

types.description: Optional exact names (1–64); unknown names fail the request. Omit for all.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Find what Fyug offers from key words or intent: tools, module types, developments, examples and packages, as ranked cards saying what each is, when to use it and how. Hosted: this server's tools and bundled content only.

words.description: Key words or intent, e.g. "reverb", "make it brighter"

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Report what this server can do (it is not connected to a running Fyug), with the URL for installing Fyug and how to open a downloaded piece there.

tools.name: get_summary
tools.description: What a local Fyug's get_summary says just after loading a piece: title, module and connection counts, the first modules, each clock. Nothing plays here, so it reads as stopped. Pass exactly one of json or ref. Refuses what check_invention refuses. Returns { summary }.

json.description: Invention JSON string, at most 64 KiB.

ref.description: Exact ref object, copied from list_examples.

tools.name: import_score
tools.description: Convert a MusicXML score into a fugue.score.v1 asset, answering as a local import_score does inline. Pass musicxml, the score's text (not a path, URL or zipped .mxl). Returns the conversion summary and score. To play it, give each cell its own cell_sequencer: cells [score.cells[i]] inline, step_count steps_per_cell, root_note score.root_note, clocked once per rhythm_grid step. An answer past 64 KiB is refused. Nothing is stored.

musicxml.description: The score's MusicXML text (partwise), at most 256 KiB.

tools.name: install_package
tools.description: Hosted: answers for bundled packages only and installs nothing. A bundled id (or id@version; a version must be the bundled one) answers already_installed: true with the package entry and its ref for developments: [{name, ref}]. Any other source (local:, github:, an id not bundled) is refused; install it in the desktop app.

tools.name: list_developments
tools.description: Discover the reusable instruments and other developments bundled with this release; look here before building an instrument from module types. Returns stable IDs, exact versions, summaries and importable refs; does not load or play anything. Use schema_version: 1. Limit defaults to 20 (1–100); optional source/id filters and opaque cursor. Copy a ref into describe_development, then developments: [{name: YOUR_ALIAS, ref: RETURNED_REF}] in an invention.

ContentKind.description: Available musical content classification, independent of registered types.

ContentSource.description: Delivery provenance; it never changes package identity.

tools.name: list_examples
tools.description: Discover the playable examples bundled with this release. Returns compact summaries and exact refs; does not load or play anything. Use schema_version: 1. Limit defaults to 20 (1–100); optional source/id filters and opaque cursor; kind, when supplied, must be invention. Copy a returned ref into describe_example, or into load_invention to play it. An item the browser cannot play says why under browser.

ContentKind.description: Available musical content classification, independent of registered types.

ContentSource.description: Delivery provenance; it never changes package identity.

tools.name: list_packages
tools.description: List the built-in module types and the packages bundled with this release: id, exact version, kind, source, summary and, for developments and inventions, a ref to pass unchanged to describe_development, describe_example or developments: [{name, ref}]. Hosted: bundled packages only.

oneOf.description: Staged from content shipped with the release.
Installed into the package cache by an install command.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page with the same filters.

detail.description: Include dependencies and module types. Off by default to keep pages small.

id.description: Only the package with this exact ID (every installed version).

kind.description: Only packages of this manifest kind.

tools.name: load_invention
tools.description: load_invention opens the in-chat player with a piece, which plays in the user's browser once they tap Play (its sound may drop out on a busy device). When local Fyug tools are present, load the piece with them instead. Pass exactly one of json or ref (the player fetches a ref), and optionally controls for the person to play (one the piece lacks fails the call, naming it). A document is checked as check_invention checks it, and also fails, naming what it used, when it needs what the browser lacks (a bundled sample its engine does not carry, a module type it does not build). Succeeds with {playable, version, module_count, connection_count, controls}, plus not_run naming each script or agent module the player builds but does not run, and runs_in_player naming the scripts it runs (sandboxed, no network). While open, the player offers tools on the piece it holds (list_controls, get_control, set_control, set_controls, apply_edits, get_invention, pause_invention, resume_invention, get_notes for the notes it will play, get_meters); it sends the levels at load and the controls the person changes (list_changed_controls lists them): a value the person changed is theirs, so do not set it back, and carry it into any new document. Nothing is stored.

anyOf.description: An exact installed package version; never a SemVer requirement.
A file and dependency-closure revision relative to the daemon workspace.

key.description: Control key, as describe_module or list_controls names it.

module_id.description: Module instance id, as the document names it.

controls.description: Controls the player shows the person, at most 16, each a module id and a control key (describe_module lists a module's controls), drawn as the local control panel draws them and grouped by module.

json.description: Complete invention JSON string (with modules, connections, etc.), at most 64 KiB.

ref.description: Exact ref of a bundled example, copied from list_examples.

tools.name: read_document
tools.description: For the in-chat player, not agents: a json document, checked as load_invention checks it, with its bundled developments written in.

json.description: Complete invention JSON string (with modules, connections, etc.), at most 64 KiB.

tools.name: read_example
tools.description: For the in-chat player, not agents: a bundled example's document, by ref.

tools.name: validate_score
tools.description: Validate a fugue.score.v1 asset with the library validator, answering as a local validate_score does. Pass score, the asset itself (not a path or URL). Returns {valid, error?}: an invalid score is an answer, not a failure.

tools.name: create_invention
tools.description: Not available here: the in-chat player opens only a complete piece; instead, open a small document with load_invention.
